crime.value: Drowning death of Bobby Thompson at summer camp; central question: was it accident or homicide, and who had motive/opportunity?
crime.quote: Bobby Thompson had an accident, that's all. Mr. Whiteman will tell you all about it in the morning.

victim.value: Bobby Thompson, camper in Bunk 9 who bullied Arnold by cutting his tennis racket strings and stealing his radio tube; was 'killable' due to being a bully with few defenders
victim.quote: I heard that somebody cut all the strings off your tennis racket... somebody stole a tube from your radio set.

closed_world.value: Camp Summit, an isolated summer camp accessible only by five-hour drive, with defined bunks, activities schedule, and staff supervision creating limited suspect pool
closed_world.quote: Camp Summit drowsed in the two o'clock heat... Father can send Walter up with the car, it is only a five hour drive

investigator.value: Mr. Whiteman, camp director, who discovers Arnold's revelation about Bobby Thompson and begins investigation; reader also sees through Arnold's perspective
investigator.quote: Mr. Whiteman paled. 'Did you...say Bobby Thompson was the boy who was giving you trouble?'... He pulled on his coat and began to run.
